image_description: A high-angle shot of a rock climber scaling a steep, textured cliff face. The climber, wearing a red shirt and light-colored pants, is positioned centrally, gripping the rock with hands and feet. The rock surface is rough, gray-brown, and fills the majority of the frame, showing natural weathering and small crevices.
